threatFindings.impact: B069 estimated about 0.03 points/battle on the strong pool (15% of cohorts have 2 or more routers). h34 recovers almost all of it with one immediate. Narrows B069's mechanism hypothesis: the collapse comes from zombies that enter zombie_entry with CX=0 and then build phoenixes at B's band + 34h. The geometric cause (lattice relation of 34h to B's 10h at step 2C00h, or the 0E070E17 -> CC counter-bomb charge) is still untraced.

recommendation: promote-candidate as a defense add-on: use h34 (B: mov bp,3400h -> 7000h only) instead of full zph in the next combination. It removes the verified 2-router theft self-kill (+0.192 vs zph +0.200 on the same cohorts) and had no detected general cost (screen +0.018, no negative group; single-copy zrl03/zchain4/ah02 unchanged, while zph lost there). Port into K/Z1-based B: K_B.asm still has `mov bp, 3400h` at zombie_entry (line 53); change only that immediate. Do not include the 2000h -> 5C00h half (h20 is -0.060 on the router cohorts). As a stand-alone promotion it would face the same problem as zph (mc03n pooled lo < 0): the router case is mostly absent from the 2025/2024 pools, so expect its pooled effect to be small; its value is in the strong/threat groups.
